expected_legal_description:
LAND AND PREMISES SITUATE IN THE BOROUGH OF HADDONFIELD,
COUNTY OF CAMDEN AND STATE OF NEW JERSEY BOUNDED AND DESCRIBED
AS FOLLOWS:

BEGINNING AT THE WEST CORNER OF HADDON AND EUCLID (FORMERLY
REDMAN STREET) AVENUES; THENCE

1.  NORTHWEST ALONG THE SOUTHWEST LINE OF HADDON AVENUE 129
    FEET; THENCE

2.  SOUTHWEST, FORMING AN INTERIOR ANGLE OF 89 DEGREES 43
    MINUTES 30 SECONDS, PARALLEL WITH EUCLID AVENUE, 200 FEET TO THE
    NORTHEAST LINE OF TURNLEY AVENUE; THENCE

3.  SOUTHEAST, FORMING AN INTERIOR ANGLE OF 90 DEGREES 16
    MINUTES 10 SECONDS WITH LAST MENTIONED COURSE, AND RUNNING ALONG
    THE NORTHEAST LINE OF TURNLEY AVENUE, 129 FEET TO THE NORTHEAST
    LINE OF EUCLID AVENUE; AND THENCE

4.  NORTHEAST FORMING AN INTERIOR ANGLE OF 89 DEGREES 43
    MINUTES 30 SECONDS WITH TURNLEY AVENUE AND RUNNING ALONG THE
    NORTHWEST LINE OF EUCLID AVENUE 200 FEET TO THE SOUTHWEST LINE
    OF HADDON AVENUE AND PLACE OF BEGINNING.

BEING KNOWN AS LOTS 6 AND 9, BLOCK 130 AS SHOWN ON THE
TAX MAP.
